telemetry.title: VoiceCraft Usage Dashboard
telemetry.subtitle: Live aggregates from the public telemetry API, split into readable client and server telemetry views.

roles.clientShort: VoiceCraft app installs, devices, and client settings
roles.clientDescription: Client data comes from startup reports and diagnostic uploads from VoiceCraft clients. The page focuses on installs, operating systems, runtime details, device families, positioning mode, and push-to-talk usage.
roles.serverShort: VoiceCraft.Server runtime, host, and transport reports
roles.serverDescription: Server data comes from startup, heartbeat, and diagnostic reports from VoiceCraft.Server. The page focuses on installs, host platforms, runtime details, capacity, connected clients, positioning mode, and enabled transports.

telemetry.loadingSubtitle: The dashboard is pulling current aggregates from vc-api.avion.team.
telemetry.emptyTitle: Telemetry is online, but there is no usage data yet
telemetry.emptySubtitle: As soon as VoiceCraft clients or servers start reporting events, the charts here will populate automatically.
telemetry.noChartData: No data for this chart yet.
telemetry.partialData: Some secondary charts could not be loaded, so the dashboard is showing the data that was available.

charts.osShareSubtitle: Where VoiceCraft is running right now.
charts.uniqueOsShareSubtitle: Latest known OS split by unique fingerprint.
charts.channelShareSubtitle: How usage is split across stable and other channels.
charts.roleShareSubtitle: Observed roles in the telemetry stream.
charts.versionShareSubtitle: Most active app versions in the current snapshot.
charts.osVersionShareSubtitle: Reported operating system versions for the selected telemetry dataset.
charts.osBuildShareSubtitle: Build identifiers reported by client devices.
charts.osDescriptionShareSubtitle: Full operating system descriptions reported by clients.
charts.processArchitectureShareSubtitle: Process architecture that the app is currently running under.
charts.localeShareSubtitle: Most common user locales reported by clients.
charts.vendorShareSubtitle: Hardware vendors seen in anonymous reports.
charts.serverPlatformShareSubtitle: Host platforms reported by server telemetry.
charts.serverConnectedClientsSubtitle: How many clients servers report as connected right now.
charts.serverMaxClientsSubtitle: Configured capacity buckets reported by servers.
charts.dumpCategoryShareSubtitle: Crash, log, and diagnostic dump distribution.
charts.transportHttpSubtitle: Value distribution for the `mc_http_enabled` server metric.
charts.transportTcpSubtitle: Value distribution for the `mc_tcp_enabled` server metric.
charts.transportWssSubtitle: Value distribution for the `mc_wss_enabled` server metric.

addonConfigurator.title: World-ready VoiceCraft Addon Builder
addonConfigurator.subtitle: Choose the base addon and transport packs, upload your world level.dat, optionally add level.dat_old, and download a ready-to-unpack archive for the world folder.
addonConfigurator.uploadSubtitle: The file will be included in the archive after the Bedrock experiment tags are patched.
addonConfigurator.uploadOldSubtitle: If provided, the backup file is patched the same way and added to the archive as level.dat_old.
addonConfigurator.uploadBehaviorJsonSubtitle: If provided, existing behavior pack registrations are preserved and VoiceCraft entries are added.
addonConfigurator.uploadResourceJsonSubtitle: If provided, existing resource pack registrations are preserved and VoiceCraft entries are added.
addonConfigurator.betaApiStub: The configurator enables the Bedrock experiment tags needed for the beta API directly inside level.dat.
addonConfigurator.summarySubtitle: The final zip is laid out so it can be unpacked directly into a Bedrock world folder.

outputs.levelDat: World save metadata with Bedrock beta API experiment tags enabled.
outputs.levelDatOldIncluded: Optional backup world metadata file, patched and included in the archive.
outputs.levelDatOldOptional: Optional backup world metadata file. Added only when you upload it.
outputs.behaviorJson: Generated pack registration file for behavior packs.
outputs.behaviorJsonMerged: Uploaded behavior pack registrations with VoiceCraft entries added.
outputs.resourceJson: Generated pack registration file for resource packs.
outputs.resourceJsonMerged: Uploaded resource pack registrations with VoiceCraft entries added.
outputs.behaviorFolder: Behavior packs copied from the selected addon bundles.
outputs.resourceFolder: Resource packs copied from the selected addon bundles.
